a.captive: Open a browser and log in on the network page (hotel, station, guest).
a.dns_all_fail: Check the Internet connection and the configured DNS servers.
a.dns_differs: Compare with another network; check DNS filtering or an internal record.
a.dns_filter: This network's DNS (corporate, parental control, ISP) filters this name: check the filtering policy.
a.dns_interception: The network redirects all DNS: configured public DNS servers are not really used.
a.dns_local_fail: Restart the router or change DNS server (e.g. 1.1.1.1).
a.dns_nx: Check the spelling of the name or the domain registration.
a.gateway_down: Restart the router, check the cable or Wi-Fi connection.
a.h3_blocked: Allow outbound UDP 443 if HTTP/3 is wanted; otherwise harmless.
a.http_forbidden: Check access rights, IP filtering or a web application firewall.
a.http_no_answer: The server or an intermediate device blocks the request: check server or proxy side.
a.http_proxy_auth: Configure proxy credentials in the browser or application.
a.http_server_error: Forward to the site administrator, the network is not at fault.
a.ipv6_broken: Fix the server's IPv6 or remove the AAAA record.
a.no_network: Check the cable or Wi-Fi, then whether an IP address is obtained (DHCP).
a.nxdomain_hijack: Usually harmless; may disturb some applications.
a.path_loop: Routing problem: contact the provider or network administrator.
a.path_loss: If loss starts at the provider, send them this report.
a.proto_failed: Check the service configuration on the server.
a.proto_no_tls: Enable STARTTLS / TLS on the server to avoid sending credentials in clear.
a.rdp_no_nla: Require Network Level Authentication (NLA) on the server.
a.ssh_obsolete: Disable obsolete algorithms in the SSH server configuration.
a.tcp_filtered_server: Ask the server administrator to open the port (firewall, security group).
a.tcp_refused: Check that the service runs on the server and the port number.
a.tcp_timeout: Test from another network to know whether the block is local or server-side.
a.tcp_timeout_local: Check the firewall of the computer, router or local network.
a.tcp_timeout_path: The block is outside the local network: contact the provider or host with this report.
a.tcp_unreachable: Check the address and routing (VPN, private network).
a.tls_handshake: Check the server TLS configuration or filtering (firewall, DPI).
a.tls_intercepted: Normal if intended; otherwise exclude the site from TLS inspection (apps with certificate pinning).
a.tls_intercepted_untrusted: Install the company authority on the computer or exclude this site from TLS inspection.
a.tls_missing_intermediate: Configure the server to send the full chain (fullchain).
a.tls_server_cert: Renew or fix the server certificate.
a.tls_weak: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak suites on the server.
a.transparent_proxy: Check with the network administrator; sensitive applications may not cope well.

tui.subtitle: read-only diagnosis
usage:
Jalon — layer-by-layer connectivity diagnosis (read-only)

Usage:
  jalon [options] target [target…]    e.g. https://example.com  smtp://mail.example.com  10.0.0.5:3389
  jalon -f targets.txt                one target per line (# = comment)
  jalon tui target…                   terminal interface (cascade + live MTR)
  jalon web                           local web interface (127.0.0.1)
  jalon history [filter]              list history; "history purge 30d" purges
  jalon diff <id1> <id2>              compare two diagnoses
  jalon version                       show the version

Reports: --format html,md,json,ticket (in jalon-data/rapports), --report-lang fr|en.
Data: jalon-data/ next to the executable (config.yaml, historique/, rapports/); --data or JALON_DATA.
Exit codes: 0 OK, 1 warning, 2 diagnosis failed, 3 usage or execution error.

Options:
v.captive: Captive portal detected: a login page intercepts traffic
v.dns_all_fail: Cannot resolve {1}: no DNS resolver answers
v.dns_differs: Local DNS returns a different IP than public resolvers → filtering likely
v.dns_fallback: Diagnosis continued with addresses from a public resolver
v.dns_interception: DNS queries to public resolvers are intercepted on this network
v.dns_local_fail: Local DNS does not answer, public resolvers do
v.dns_local_nx: Local DNS claims {1} does not exist while public resolvers know it → filtering likely
v.dns_sinkhole: Local DNS blocks {1} (blocking address) → DNS filtering
v.gateway_down: The problem is before the router: gateway {1} does not answer
v.h3_blocked: HTTP/3 advertised but QUIC fails: UDP 443 probably blocked (the browser falls back to HTTP/2)
v.http_no_answer: The server accepts the connection but does not answer HTTP ({1})
v.http_server_error: The web server answers with error {1} → server-side problem
v.ipv6_broken: IPv6 advertised but broken: some clients will be slow or fail
v.no_network: The computer is not connected to any network
v.nxdomain_hijack: The DNS provider redirects non-existent names
v.path_loss: Real packet loss starting at hop {1}
v.proto_failed: The {1} service does not answer correctly
v.smtp25_blocked: Outbound port 25 seems blocked (common with ISPs)
v.ssh_obsolete: The SSH server accepts obsolete algorithms
v.tcp_filtered_server: The host answers the traceroute but port {1} is filtered → server-side firewall
v.tcp_refused: The server answers but refuses the connection on port {1} → service stopped or wrong port
v.tcp_timeout: Port {1} does not answer (filtered somewhere along the path)
v.tcp_timeout_local: Port {1} gets no answer and the path stops at hop {2} → blocked at the local router / firewall
v.tcp_timeout_path: Port {1} gets no answer and the path stops at hop {2} → blocked in the provider's network or upstream of the server
v.tls_hostname: The certificate does not match the name {1}
v.tls_intercepted: TLS traffic is decrypted by {1} (corporate proxy or antivirus)
v.tls_intercepted_untrusted: TLS traffic is decrypted by {1} whose authority is not installed
v.tls_missing_intermediate: The server does not send its intermediate certificate
v.tls_selfsigned: The server presents a self-signed certificate
v.tls_untrusted: The server certificate is not trusted by any store
v.tls_weak: The server accepts weak TLS algorithms
v.transparent_proxy: A transparent proxy is probably on the path
